# Fisherman at dawn: Flare and Sunburst

[← Back to external website archive](../../README.md#all-cases)

**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Photographic scene of an elderly fisherman mending a net on a wooden dock at dawn in fog; the source prompt requests no text. The publisher reports one attempt per prompt with no edits; this is a source example, not our benchmark or an independent reproduction. Only the Flare and Sunburst outputs are included.
